name: Single filer, Texas, $120k with $20k 401(k) + $4,000 HSA pre-tax payroll deductions
description: Exercises 401(k) reducing federal taxable wages only, and HSA reducing federal AND FICA taxable wages

sources.description: IRS 2026 brackets/standard deduction (Rev. Proc. 2025-32); IRS 2026 401(k) limit $24,500; IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-19 HSA limit $4,400
sources.notes: 401(k) deduction = min(20000, cap 24500) = 20000. HSA deduction = min(4000, cap 4400) = 4000. pretax_income_deductions = 24000. state_wage_base (federal/state taxable base) = max(0, 120000-24000) = 96000. fica_wage_base = max(0, 120000-4000) = 116000 (401k does NOT reduce FICA; HSA does). FEDERAL: standard deduction (single, 2026) = $16,100 -> taxable = max(0, 96000-16100) = 79900. Tax: 10%*12400=1240; 12%*38000=4560; 22%*29500(=79900-50400)=6490. Federal tax = 12290. STATE (Texas) = 0. FICA: SS = min(116000,184500)*6.2% = 7192. Medicare = 116000*1.45% = 1682. Additional Medicare: max(0,116000-200000)=0. total_fica = 8874. total_deductions = federal(12290) + state(0) + fica(8874) + pretax_income_deductions(24000) = 45164. net = 120000-45164 = 74836. effective_rate = 45164/120000 = 0.37637.

sources.description: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-19 - 2026 HSA contribution limits ($4,400 self-only / $8,750 family)
